about: Showcase data for the local_dimensions and block_dimensions READMEs. Read by seed_showcase.php (the records) and imagery/render.mjs (the pictures). Every idnumber the seed owns starts with SC- (frameworks, competencies, templates) or showcase (courses, cohorts, users).

growth.name: Professional growth
growth.description: Four steps from first attempts to leading others.

practice.name: Practice level
practice.description: How independently a practice is carried out.

assured.name: Assurance
assured.description: Compliance standards: assured or not yet.

frameworks.description: The values every member of staff shares: integrity, respect and professional responsibility.

domains.name: Integrity and ethics
domains.description: Acting honestly and ethically in every professional relationship.
children: Is open about decisions and their reasons, and owns mistakes.
Keeps relationships with learners and families appropriate, online and offline.
Shares personal information only when policy and law allow.

domains.name: Respect and inclusion
domains.description: Treating everyone fairly and making every learner feel they belong.
children: Listens, values each voice and keeps high expectations for all.
Notices and addresses unfair treatment, in practice and in materials.

domains.name: Professional responsibility
domains.description: Owning one's development and working within policy.
children: Engages with research and professional learning every year.
Knows the policies that apply to the role and follows them.

frameworks.description: The digital skills staff need to work, teach and stay safe in a connected organisation.

domains.name: Information and data literacy
domains.description: Finding, judging and managing information and data.
children: Searches effectively and judges the reliability of what is found.
Stores, shares and deletes data in line with data protection rules.

domains.name: Communication and collaboration
children: Co-authors documents and organises shared files so others can find them.
Writes clear, courteous messages and chooses the right channel.

domains.name: Digital content creation
domains.description: Creating digital resources others can use.
children: Uses headings, alt text and contrast so every learner can use a resource.
Uses openly licensed material and credits sources correctly.

domains.name: Safety and wellbeing online
domains.description: Keeping people, devices and data safe.
children: Uses strong authentication and recognises phishing.
Sets healthy boundaries for digital work, for self and learners.

frameworks.description: What good leadership looks like at every level, from team leader to senior leader.

domains.name: Setting direction
domains.description: Knowing where the team is going and why.
children: Explains the purpose of the work in a way that motivates others.
Turns priorities into a realistic plan with milestones.

domains.name: Developing people
children: Offers specific, timely feedback that helps colleagues improve.
Spots talent, delegates well and plans for succession.

domains.name: Leading the organisation
children: Plans budgets and time so that priorities are funded.
Weighs data and research before deciding.

frameworks.description: Habits that keep individuals and teams healthy, resilient and able to do their best work.

domains.name: Personal resilience
children: Plans the week, protects focus time and says no when needed.
Knows personal warning signs and acts on them early.

domains.name: Healthy teams
children: Checks in on colleagues and knows where to point them for help.
Makes it safe to ask questions, disagree and admit mistakes.

frameworks.description: The classroom practices with the strongest evidence of impact on learning.

domains.name: Planning for learning
domains.description: Designing lessons around what learners need to know next.
children: Shares what will be learned and what success looks like.
Orders content so each lesson builds on the last.
Checks and activates what learners already know.

domains.name: Instruction
children: Breaks complex ideas into steps and thinks aloud.
Asks questions that make every learner think, not only volunteers.
Removes support gradually until learners work alone.

domains.name: Learning environment
domains.description: A calm, purposeful room where everyone can learn.
children: Teaches routines explicitly and keeps them consistent.
Knows learners well and shows warmth and high expectations.

frameworks.description: Designing a curriculum that is ambitious, coherent and reviewed for impact.

domains.name: Curriculum intent
children: Identifies the knowledge every learner must secure.
Maps outcomes to the standards they serve.

domains.name: Implementation
domains.description: Turning intent into units and lessons.
children: Plans units with a clear arc and assessment points.
Builds retrieval and spaced practice into the sequence.

domains.name: Review
children: Uses work scrutiny and data to refine the curriculum.

frameworks.description: Using assessment to find out what learners know and to decide what to teach next.

domains.name: Formative assessment
children: Checks for understanding in real time
Uses mini whiteboards, cold calling and exit tickets to see every learner's thinking.
Asks a diagnostic question before moving on.
Responds to evidence in the moment
Changes the plan when the evidence says so.

domains.name: Feedback
children: Tells learners exactly what to do next and gives time to do it.
Teaches learners to judge work against success criteria.

domains.name: Summative assessment
children: Writes tasks that measure what was taught.
Describes quality clearly at each level.
Compares marking with colleagues to agree standards.

frameworks.description: Teaching well with technology, from purposeful tools to generative AI.

domains.name: Technology-enhanced learning
children: Chooses a tool only when it improves the learning.
Builds activities in which learners do the thinking.

domains.name: Blended design
children: Decides what happens online and what in the room, and why.
Records short, focused videos with clear structure.

domains.name: AI in education
children: Checks AI output for accuracy and bias before using it.
Sets tasks where the learning cannot be outsourced.
Helps learners understand how AI works and its limits.

frameworks.description: Facilitating live and asynchronous online learning that keeps people engaged.

domains.name: Online presence
domains.description: Being visibly present for online learners.
children: Welcomes, guides and responds so learners know someone is there.
Creates the conditions for learners to learn from each other.

domains.name: Live sessions
children: Plans for bandwidth, captions and every voice.
Gives groups a clear task, roles and a product.

domains.name: Asynchronous discussion
domains.description: Discussion that deepens thinking over time.
children: Keeps discussion respectful and on task.
Pulls threads together to show what the group has learned.

frameworks.description: Leading the quality of teaching and learning across a team or department.

domains.name: Leading teaching
children: Runs developmental observations focused on one step at a time.
Plans sessions that change what happens in classrooms.

domains.name: Data-informed improvement
children: Finds the patterns in results that matter for action.
Chooses a few priorities and sticks with them.

domains.name: Culture of learning
children: Helps the team believe they can make a difference together.
Notices and shares improvements, large and small.

frameworks.description: Planning, implementing and sustaining change so that it lasts.

domains.name: Preparing for change
domains.description: Building the case and the coalition.
children: Uses evidence to define the problem before the solution.
Involves the people affected early and listens.

domains.name: Implementing change
children: Tracks fidelity and impact and adjusts the plan.

domains.name: Sustaining change
domains.description: Making the new way the normal way.
children: Builds the change into routines, induction and policy.

frameworks.description: The skills of coaches and mentors who help colleagues grow.

domains.name: Coaching conversations
children: Listens to understand, reflects back and resists giving answers.
Asks open questions that help the coachee find their own way.
Ends each conversation with a clear, owned next step.

domains.name: Mentoring new colleagues
domains.description: Supporting colleagues at the start of their career.
children: Maps the first year with the mentee, week by week.
Shares own reflections and mistakes to normalise learning.

domains.name: Peer observation
domains.description: Observing to learn, not to judge.
children: Links feedback to what was observed and agreed foci.

frameworks.description: Teaching that removes barriers so that every learner can take part and succeed.

domains.name: Universal design
domains.description: Planning for variability from the start.
children: Offers choice and relevance so that learners want to take part.
Offers flexible ways to show learning
Accepts different products that meet the same goal.

domains.name: Language and culture
domains.description: Valuing every learner's language and background.
children: Brings learners' experiences into the curriculum.

domains.name: Additional needs
children: Adjusts layout, language and format without lowering challenge.
Plans with support staff and specialists.

frameworks.description: Promoting belonging and good mental health for every learner.

domains.name: Belonging
domains.description: Making every learner feel part of the community.
children: Greets, includes and knows every learner.
Recognises good choices and restores relationships after conflict.

domains.name: Mental health
children: Notices changes in mood, attendance or work.
Knows who to refer to and how.

frameworks.description: What every adult must know and do to keep children and young people safe.

domains.name: Recognising concerns
domains.description: Spotting the signs that a learner may be at risk.
children: Identifies signs of abuse and neglect
Knows the indicators of each category of abuse.
Recognises grooming, exploitation and harmful content online.
Considers risks outside the home, in the community and peer groups.

domains.name: Responding and reporting
domains.description: Acting on a concern without delay.
children: Listens, reassures and never promises confidentiality.
Records facts accurately and reports to the safeguarding lead the same day.

domains.name: Safe working practice
domains.description: Behaving in ways that protect learners and staff.
children: Knows and follows the staff code of conduct.
Keeps learners safe on trips and events
Plans risk assessments and supervision for off-site activities.

frameworks.description: The standards new teachers work towards in their first two years, with a mentor's support.

domains.name: Settling in
domains.description: Finding one's feet in a new school.
children: Knows the behaviour, assessment and safeguarding policies.
Works well with the mentor, team and support staff.

domains.name: Classroom practice
children: Applies the behaviour policy calmly and fairly.
Plans lessons with clear intentions and checks for understanding.
Communicates positively and promptly with parents and carers.

domains.name: Professional growth
children: Keeps a reflective journal and acts on what it shows.
Agrees termly goals with the mentor and reviews them.

frameworks.description: Teaching, supervising and assessing learners in clinical and simulated settings.

domains.name: Teaching in clinical settings
children: Turns patient encounters into structured teaching moments.
Demonstrates, observes and signs off procedures safely.

domains.name: Simulation
children: Writes scenarios with clear objectives and realistic cues.
Uses a debrief model to turn experience into learning.

domains.name: Assessment in practice
children: Uses structured tools to assess performance in practice.
Identifies difficulties early and agrees a support plan.

frameworks.description: Reading, using and protecting educational data with confidence.

domains.name: Understanding data
domains.description: Making sense of numbers and charts.
children: Interprets common charts without being misled.
Knows what a measure can and cannot tell.

domains.name: Using data
children: Targets support where the data shows the need.
Presents data clearly to colleagues and families.

domains.name: Data ethics
domains.description: Respecting the people behind the data.
children: Shares only what is needed, with those who need it.

templates.description: Your first two years as a teacher: the standards you work towards, the courses that help, and your mentor's review at each stage.

templates.shortname: Welcome to the Academy: first 90 days
templates.description: Everything a new colleague needs in the first term: policies, people, systems and safe working.
A year-long pathway through the eight practices with the strongest evidence of impact on learning.
Design or redesign a unit of work with colleagues, from intent to impact review.
Three cycles of inquiry into formative assessment, feedback and fair summative judgements.
A short programme on feedback learners act on, peer assessment and responsive teaching.
From purposeful tools to blended design and generative AI: teaching well with technology.
Use generative AI critically, design tasks AI cannot shortcut, and teach learners how AI works.
Earn the certificate by facilitating live and asynchronous sessions that keep every learner engaged.
For heads of department and team leaders: lead teaching, use data well and build a culture of learning.
Plan and lead one improvement project from diagnosis to lasting change.
Coach a colleague through three cycles and evidence the skills of a certified instructional coach.
Become an accredited mentor for early-career teachers.
Universal design, language support and adaptive teaching, so that every learner takes part.
For staff who lead wellbeing: learner belonging, mental health and healthy teams.
The mandatory yearly update for every member of staff. Complete it before the end of the first half term.
Advanced training for designated safeguarding leads and their deputies.
Teach, simulate and assess with confidence in clinical settings.
Read, use and protect educational data with confidence.
Simple, evidence-based habits that protect your wellbeing and your team's.
The first step into leadership: direction, people and decisions.

roles.description: Reviews and rates the learning plans of the colleagues they mentor. Assigned over a cohort through cohort roles.

roles.name: Head of department
roles.description: Oversees and signs off the learning plans of a department. Assigned over a cohort through cohort roles.

cohorts.description: Health staff who teach and supervise learners in practice.
